_notes: Tirisfal rebuild named-rare + boss loot (2026-10-22). One item drops per kill from the creature's pool. Numbers from the real loot formulas (tools/build_tirisfal_content.py).

Ressan the Needler.name: Needle-Fang Dirk
Ressan the Needler.flavor_text: A bat's tooth the length of your finger, honed to a point you can barely see.

Ressan the Needler.name: Duskwing Mantle
Ressan the Needler.flavor_text: Stitched from wing membrane. It flaps when you run and it never quite stops.

Ressan the Needler.name: Echolocator's Cord
Ressan the Needler.flavor_text: It hums at a pitch only the dead can hear. Nobody has told the living.

Ressan the Needler.name: Shrill Whistle Pendant
Ressan the Needler.flavor_text: Blow it and every bat in the Vale turns to look. Do not blow it.

Murk the Bloated.name: Murk's Waterlogged Cudgel
Murk the Bloated.flavor_text: Swollen with pond water. Every swing leaves a puddle.

Murk the Bloated.name: Bog-Slick Waders
Murk the Bloated.flavor_text: Tall, black and permanently damp. They will never smell like anything else.

Murk the Bloated.name: Bloat-Skin Vest
Murk the Bloated.flavor_text: Stretched hide, drum-tight. It holds in more than it should.

Murk the Bloated.name: Silt-Crusted Ring
Murk the Bloated.flavor_text: Something fell in the pond with this on its finger. It was not the first.

Goodman Solliden.name: Solliden's Rusted Pitchfork
Goodman Solliden.flavor_text: Three tines, two of them straight. It has been through a harvest and a siege.

Goodman Solliden.name: Harvest-Blighted Overalls
Goodman Solliden.flavor_text: Patched at the knee, stained at the hem. The pockets are full of seed that will never grow.

Goodman Solliden.name: Scarecrow-Stuffed Hat
Goodman Solliden.flavor_text: Straw sticks out of the brim. Some of the straw is looking at you.

Goodman Solliden.name: Pumpkin-Vine Belt
Goodman Solliden.flavor_text: Braided vine, tough as rope. It still blooms in the dark, which is unsettling.

Old Gillrot.name: Gillrot's Tidecaller Staff
Old Gillrot.flavor_text: Driftwood bound with kelp and a salt-white pearl. The tide answers it, a little too eagerly.

Old Gillrot.name: Kelp-Sodden Robe
Old Gillrot.flavor_text: It has never been dry. It does not seem to want to be.

Old Gillrot.name: Pearl-Studded Circlet
Old Gillrot.flavor_text: Oracle-pearls, set by someone who did not know what they were.

Old Gillrot.name: Brinewrack Ring
Old Gillrot.flavor_text: Cold, salt-pitted and humming a very old tune.

Meven Korgal.name: Korgal's Zealot Blade
Meven Korgal.flavor_text: Blessed once, polished daily, and keen enough that the blessing is almost beside the point.

Meven Korgal.name: Crusader's Oathplate Pauldrons
Meven Korgal.flavor_text: Crimson enamel over dented plate. An oath is scratched on the inside.

Meven Korgal.name: Standard-Bearer's Tabard
Meven Korgal.flavor_text: The Crusade's red, faded from carrying it in the rain.

Meven Korgal.name: Hallowed Prayer Beads
Meven Korgal.flavor_text: Worn smooth. Some of the prayers on them are for you.

Reaper-Lord Aldous.name: Aldous' Harvest Scythe
Reaper-Lord Aldous.flavor_text: The manor's reapers were all cut from his pattern. So was this.

Reaper-Lord Aldous.name: Death's Hour Cowl
Reaper-Lord Aldous.flavor_text: A hood that remembers when the manor's clock stopped.

Reaper-Lord Aldous.name: Manor Reaper's Coat
Reaper-Lord Aldous.flavor_text: Black leather, old stitching, a hundred small cuts.

Reaper-Lord Aldous.name: Cold Hearth Brazier Charm
Reaper-Lord Aldous.flavor_text: Ash and iron. It glows when the manor's chimney draws.

Captain Dargol.name: Dargol's Family Blade
Captain Dargol.flavor_text: Handed down in the Agamand line and, eventually, back up out of the crypt.

Captain Dargol.name: Crypt-Captain's Hauberk
Captain Dargol.flavor_text: Mail the colour of old rain, rusted along the seams.

Captain Dargol.name: Ancestral Signet
Captain Dargol.flavor_text: A family crest, worn thin. The family did not do the wearing.

Captain Dargol.name: Mausoleum Ward-Shield
Captain Dargol.flavor_text: A slab of crypt door with a handle. It was built to keep things in.

Maggot Eye.name: Maggot Eye's Gnoll-Smasher
Maggot Eye.flavor_text: A fence-post, a chunk of anvil, and a great deal of ill will.

Maggot Eye.name: Rot Hide Warpaint Vest
Maggot Eye.flavor_text: Hide, stained in colours no gnoll ever wore on purpose.

Maggot Eye.name: Gnawed Bone Necklace
Maggot Eye.flavor_text: Every bone is a bite-mark. Every bite-mark is a story.

Maggot Eye.name: Maggot-Crusted Gloves
Maggot Eye.flavor_text: Do not look inside. They are warm.

Thurman Agamand.name: Thurman's Miller's Maul
Thurman Agamand.flavor_text: The mill's mallet, grown heavy with a family's grudge.

Thurman Agamand.name: Mill-Dust Bracers
Thurman Agamand.flavor_text: Leather caked in grey flour that is not flour.

Thurman Agamand.name: Agamand Family Crest
Thurman Agamand.flavor_text: A cracked gold pendant. The crest is a mill-wheel and a wreath.

Thurman Agamand.name: Grinding-Stone Belt
Thurman Agamand.flavor_text: Iron links and a millstone buckle. It never shifts.

Bethor Iceshard.name: Iceshard Scepter
Bethor Iceshard.flavor_text: A sliver of lake-ice that has refused to melt for three seasons.

Bethor Iceshard.name: Frostbitten Mage-Robe
Bethor Iceshard.flavor_text: Frozen stiff on the shoulders and warm, strangely, at the heart.

Bethor Iceshard.name: Brightwater Shard Pendant
Bethor Iceshard.flavor_text: A shard of the lake bed, clear as glass. It shows you somewhere else.

Bethor Iceshard.name: Rimed Gauntlets
Bethor Iceshard.flavor_text: They crackle when you close your fists.

Captain Melrache.name: Melrache's Zealot Cleaver
Captain Melrache.flavor_text: A broad axe from the Crusade's armoury, notched with Forsaken tallies.

Captain Melrache.name: Faol's Rest Warplate
Captain Melrache.flavor_text: The captain's own, hammered back into shape a dozen times.

Captain Melrache.name: Rallying Banner Cloak
Captain Melrache.flavor_text: Cut from a regimental banner. It still smells of candle-smoke.

Captain Melrache.name: Crusader Captain's Greaves
Captain Melrache.flavor_text: Heavy and polished. The polish is mostly vanity.

Crusader Brennic.name: Brennic's Shieldwall
Crusader Brennic.flavor_text: A tower of dented steel painted Crusade red. It has stopped more than blades.

Crusader Brennic.name: Outpost Lance
Crusader Brennic.flavor_text: A cavalry lance with no cavalry left to carry it.

Crusader Brennic.name: Crusader's Mail Coif
Crusader Brennic.flavor_text: Rings of steel, rubbed bright. Whoever wore it prayed in it.

Crusader Brennic.name: Oath-Bound Bracers
Crusader Brennic.flavor_text: Iron cuffs engraved with the Crusade's vows.

Mother Venomweb.name: Venomweb Fang
Mother Venomweb.flavor_text: A fang as long as a dagger. It weeps when you hold it.

Mother Venomweb.name: Brood-Mother's Silk Wrap
Mother Venomweb.flavor_text: Pale silk, woven tight, warm with something still alive.

Mother Venomweb.name: Vale-Walker's Chitin Cap
Mother Venomweb.flavor_text: Cunningly layered shell, cut for a head with fewer eyes.

Mother Venomweb.name: Cocoon-Wrapped Cloak
Mother Venomweb.flavor_text: Something struggled in this once. It kept the shape.

Captain Vachon.name: Vachon's Balnir Saber
Captain Vachon.flavor_text: A cavalry saber, ground thin. The stable-boys call it 'Old Faithful'.

Captain Vachon.name: Stable-Warden's Hauberk
Captain Vachon.flavor_text: Chain over leather, smelling of hay and horse.

Captain Vachon.name: Pitted Captain's Pauldrons
Captain Vachon.flavor_text: Dented in a dozen places. He called each dent by name.

Captain Vachon.name: Rusted Horseshoe Charm
Captain Vachon.flavor_text: Lucky, they say. The horse it came off would disagree.

Cult Overseer Thaddeus.name: Thaddeus' Shadowlash Rod
Cult Overseer Thaddeus.flavor_text: A black rod that lashes out without being swung.

Cult Overseer Thaddeus.name: Overseer's Black Vestments
Cult Overseer Thaddeus.flavor_text: Wool the colour of a closed eye. The cult's sigil is stitched where the heart would be.

Cult Overseer Thaddeus.name: Ledger-Keeper's Ring
Cult Overseer Thaddeus.flavor_text: Engraved with a tally that never reaches the bottom of the page.

Interrogator Vishas.name: Vishas' Branding Iron
Interrogator Vishas.flavor_text: The head is shaped like the Crusade's sunburst. The reason is not pleasant.

Interrogator Vishas.name: Interrogator's Black Coat
Interrogator Vishas.flavor_text: Leather, buckled to the throat. It does not creak when he walks.

Interrogator Vishas.name: Penance Gauntlets
Interrogator Vishas.flavor_text: Studded on the inside. You find out why.

Interrogator Vishas.name: Confessor's Signet
Interrogator Vishas.flavor_text: Everyone who has worn it said exactly what he wanted to hear.
